lead_summary.zh: 利雅德高樓再遇襲；台股飆3310點費半挫7.9%
lead_summary.en: Riyadh tower hit again; TAIEX up 3,310, SOX down 7.9%

title.zh: 利雅德最高樓一週內二度遇襲　11人受傷
title.en: Riyadh's tallest tower hit for second time in a week; 11 hurt

body.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德阿布杜拉國王金融區一棟高樓 24 日再度遭不明飛行物擊中，法新社引述目擊者與消息人士指為 80 層、高 385 公尺的公共投資基金（PIF）大樓，這是不到一週內第二次遇襲。沙國民防單位表示有 11 人受傷，至少 2 人嚴重燒傷、情況危急，傷者包括印度、尼泊爾、埃及籍人士與沙國公民。聯軍發言人馬爾基稱這是針對金融中心建築的卑劣恐怖攻擊，相關單位正勘查現場；受伊朗支持的胡塞組織曾宣稱發動上週的攻擊，但未對此次事件表態。
body.en: A high-rise in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District was struck by an unidentified projectile on November 24, the second hit in under a week; AFP, citing witnesses and sources, identified it as the 80-storey, 385-metre Public Investment Fund (PIF) Tower. Saudi civil defence said 11 people were injured, at least two critically with severe burns, including Indian, Nepali and Egyptian nationals and Saudi citizens. Coalition spokesman Turki al-Malki called it a vile terrorist attack on a financial-district building and said authorities were inspecting the site; the Iran-backed Houthis claimed last week's strike but have not commented on this one.

title.zh: 美擬依補貼調查加徵關稅　最快本週公布
title.en: US eyes tariffs from subsidy probe, results as soon as this week

body.zh: 《華爾街日報》引述知情人士報導，美國貿易代表葛里爾最快本週公布一項歷時數月的產業補貼調查結果，對象涵蓋中國、歐盟及另外 14 國，時程仍可能變動。報導指出，已與美國達成貿易協議的歐盟、日本、南韓稅率可能在 15% 以下，中國因補貼規模特別大可能面臨較高稅率，鋼鋁與汽車等已另課關稅的品項可能排除在外。葛里爾先前表示，相關補貼造成產能過剩並傷害美國生產者；美國貿易代表署拒絕置評，白宮未回應。台灣方面則力拚最終稅率 15%。
body.en: The Wall Street Journal, citing people familiar with the matter, reported that US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer could release as soon as this week the results of a months-long probe into industrial subsidies covering China, the EU and 14 other countries, though the timing may change. The report said the EU, Japan and South Korea, which have trade deals with Washington, could face rates of 15% or lower, China a higher rate because of the scale of its subsidies, and steel, aluminium and autos already tariffed under other authority might be excluded. Greer has said such subsidies create overcapacity that hurts US producers; USTR declined to comment and the White House did not respond. Taiwan is pressing for a final rate of 15%.

title.zh: 以防長：伊朗研發化武　揚言必要時先發制人
title.en: Israel's defence chief says Iran developing chemical arms

body.zh: 以色列國防部長卡茨 24 日透過聲明表示，伊朗正在研發化學武器，但尚不具備以此攻擊以色列的能力，並稱不能坐視此事持續，向媒體簡報時提到必要時可能對德黑蘭採取先發制人打擊。此前美國有線電視新聞網（CNN）引述美方情報報導伊朗曾規劃在華府引爆「髒彈」，伊朗外長阿拉格齊斥之為伊拉克戰爭式的宣傳、稱沒人會相信；報導未見伊方針對卡茨化武說法的回應。
body.en: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said in a statement on November 24 that Iran is developing chemical weapons but cannot yet use them to attack Israel, adding that this cannot be allowed to continue, and raised with reporters the possibility of a pre-emptive strike on Tehran if needed. CNN had earlier cited US intelligence on an alleged Iranian plan for a dirty bomb in Washington, which Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi dismissed as Iraq-war-style propaganda that no one would believe; no Iranian response to Katz's chemical-weapons claim was reported.

title.zh: 以軍空襲加薩　哈瑪斯內部安全首長身亡
title.en: Israeli strike in Gaza kills Hamas internal security chief

body.zh: 據加薩醫護與警方消息，以色列 24 日空襲擊斃哈瑪斯加薩內部安全機構負責人阿布納赫爾（Naeem Abu Nahel），另有 6 人死亡，其中包括 2 名警員。以色列軍方與國家安全局發表聯合聲明，表示打擊了一名哈瑪斯資深武裝分子。同日汗尤尼斯一處警察哨所與內扎林走廊附近另各有 3 人喪生；前一天賈巴利亞也有一名聯合國近東巴勒斯坦難民救濟工作署人員遭空襲身亡，以軍表示正在調查。
body.en: Gaza medics and police said an Israeli airstrike on November 24 killed Naeem Abu Nahel, head of Hamas's internal security apparatus in Gaza, along with six others including two police officers. Israel's military and Shin Bet said in a joint statement that they had struck a senior Hamas militant. Separately, three people died at a police post in Khan Younis and three near the Netzarim corridor, and a day earlier a UNRWA worker was killed in a strike in Jabalia, which the Israeli military said it was examining.

title.zh: 俄軍夜襲札波羅熱2死　歐盟推第22輪制裁
title.en: Russian strike kills 2 in Zaporizhzhia; EU unveils 22nd sanctions

body.zh: 烏克蘭官員 24 日表示，俄軍夜間攻擊東南部城市札波羅熱，擊中一棟公寓大樓，造成 2 人死亡、數十人受傷，傷者包括 4 名兒童。澤倫斯基 23 日表示掌握情報顯示俄方正準備新一波打擊。歐盟執委會 23 日公布對俄第 22 輪制裁方案，主席范德賴恩表示要讓烏克蘭有力量確保和平，也讓俄羅斯有充分理由選擇和平。
body.en: Ukrainian officials said on November 24 that an overnight Russian attack on the south-eastern city of Zaporizhzhia hit an apartment building, killing two people and wounding dozens, including four children. Zelensky said on the 23rd that intelligence showed Russia preparing new strikes. The European Commission on the 23rd unveiled its 22nd sanctions package against Russia, with President Ursula von der Leyen saying it would give Ukraine strength to secure peace and give Russia every reason to choose it.

title.zh: 上海市委書記陳吉寧　遭中紀委立案審查
title.en: Shanghai party chief Chen Jining placed under investigation

body.zh: 新華社 24 日晚間報導，中共中央政治局委員、上海市委書記陳吉寧涉嫌嚴重違紀違法，目前正接受中央紀委國家監委審查調查。陳吉寧 1964 年生，曾任清華大學校長、環境保護部部長與北京市長，現為第 20 屆中央政治局委員。官方通報未說明涉案細節。
body.en: Xinhua reported on the evening of November 24 that Chen Jining, a member of the Communist Party's Politburo and party secretary of Shanghai, is suspected of serious violations of discipline and law and is under investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission. Born in 1964, Chen previously served as president of Tsinghua University, environment minister and mayor of Beijing, and sits on the 20th Politburo. The official notice gave no details of the case.

title.zh: 戴爾營收倍增　AI訂單積壓達1323億美元
title.en: Dell revenue doubles; AI backlog hits US$132.3bn

body.zh: 戴爾 24 日美股盤後公布 2027 會計年度第三季財報，營收 549.37 億美元、年增 103%，非 GAAP 每股盈餘 9.45 美元。基礎設施事業營收年增 198%，其中 AI 優化伺服器營收 220.31 億美元、年增 291%；當季 AI 訂單 602 億美元，積壓訂單達 1,323 億美元。公司將全年營收財測由 1,920 億美元上調至 2,020 億美元，董事會並新增 250 億美元庫藏股授權。
body.en: Dell reported fiscal 2027 third-quarter results after the US close on November 24: revenue of US$54.94 billion, up 103%, and non-GAAP EPS of US$9.45. Infrastructure revenue rose 198%, with AI-optimised server revenue up 291% to US$22.03 billion; AI bookings were US$60.2 billion and the AI backlog reached US$132.3 billion. Dell raised its full-year revenue guidance from US$192 billion to US$202 billion and its board added US$25 billion in buyback authority.

title.en: Anthropic falls below IPO price; Nvidia gives back 5.9%

body.zh: Anthropic 掛牌第四個交易日（24 日）收跌 6.54% 至 81.9 美元，跌破 83 美元發行價，盤中一度低見 75.61 美元；該公司 IPO 募資 813 億美元，上市首日盤中最高曾達 115.10 美元。輝達在黃仁勳回任激勵單日大漲逾 31% 後，24 日收跌 5.86% 至 155.38 美元，美光與超微分別下跌 10.97%、8.86%，AI 相關股漲勢未能延續。
body.en: Anthropic closed down 6.54% at US$81.90 on November 24, its fourth trading day, below its US$83 IPO price after touching US$75.61 intraday; the IPO raised US$81.3 billion and the stock hit US$115.10 on its first day. Nvidia, which surged more than 31% the day before on Huang's return, fell 5.86% to US$155.38, while Micron and AMD dropped 10.97% and 8.86%, as the AI rally failed to hold.

title.zh: Fed官員鷹聲不斷　金價單日跌逾2%
title.en: Hawkish Fed talk drags gold down over 2%

body.zh: 紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯表示通膨仍然過高、要回到 2% 還有工作要做，並稱持續偏高的通膨意味政策須維持緊縮，後續是否升息取決於數據。金十數據指出，市場已完全反映聯準會 12 月升息 1 碼，升息 2 碼機率約 2%；美元升至近兩年高點。黃金 24 日回吐前一日漲幅，現貨金價一度跌至每盎司 3,552 美元、跌幅逾 2%，美國黃金期貨下跌 2.6% 至 3,558 美元。
body.en: New York Fed President John Williams said inflation remains too high with more work needed to return it to 2%, adding that persistent inflation calls for tight policy and any further hike depends on the data. Jin10 said markets fully price a 25-basis-point Fed hike in December, with about a 2% chance of 50 basis points, and the dollar rose to near a two-year high. Gold gave back the previous day's gains on November 24, with spot touching US$3,552 an ounce, down more than 2%, and US gold futures falling 2.6% to US$3,558.

title.zh: 荷莫茲傳油輪再遇襲　國際油價漲逾2%
title.en: Oil rises over 2% on report of new Hormuz tanker attack

body.zh: 荷莫茲海峽傳出又有油輪遭攻擊，蓋過美伊之間最新的外交努力，國際油價 24 日在清淡交易中走高。紐約西德州中級原油 2027 年 1 月期貨上漲 1.88 美元（2.35%）至每桶 82.05 美元，北海布蘭特原油 1 月期貨上漲 2.03 美元（2.27%）至每桶 91.40 美元。
body.en: A reported attack on another tanker in the Strait of Hormuz overshadowed the latest US-Iran diplomatic efforts, lifting oil prices in light trading on November 24. January WTI rose US$1.88 (2.35%) to US$82.05 a barrel and January Brent gained US$2.03 (2.27%) to US$91.40.

title.zh: 中國延長鎵鍺銻禁令暫停　至明年1月27日
title.en: China extends pause on gallium, germanium ban for US to Jan 27

body.zh: 中國商務部 24 日宣布，2024 年第 46 號公告中原則上不許可鎵、鍺、銻、超硬材料相關兩用物項出口美國、並對石墨嚴格審查的第二款規定，繼續暫停實施至 2027 年 1 月 27 日，暫停期自 11 月 28 日起算；前一次暫停期至 11 月 27 日。禁止兩用物項出口給美國軍事用戶或用於軍事用途的第一款規定則持續有效。消息在川習於深圳 APEC 會晤期間公布。
body.en: China's commerce ministry said on November 24 that the second clause of its 2024 Announcement No. 46, which in principle bars licences for exports of gallium, germanium, antimony and superhard-material dual-use items to the US and tightens review of graphite, will stay suspended from November 28 to January 27, 2027; the previous suspension ran to November 27. The first clause, banning dual-use exports to US military end users or for military use, remains in force. The announcement came during the Trump-Xi meeting at APEC in Shenzhen.

headline.zh: 黃仁勳回任激勵　台股狂飆3310點重返4萬

body.zh: 受輝達宣布黃仁勳回任執行長激勵，加權指數 24 日跳空大漲、以 39,148.91 點開盤並以此為當日低點，盤中最高 40,180.38 點，終場上漲 3,310.46 點（8.99%）收 40,122.35 點，重回 4 萬點之上；上市 1,077 家上漲、28 家下跌、7 家平盤，上市櫃逾 600 檔鎖漲停，櫃買指數也大漲逾 8%。台積電上漲 200 元至 2,230 元，聯發科漲至 4,050 元、鴻海漲至 226.5 元、台達電漲至 1,085 元，漲幅皆近一成，金融類股上漲 8.74%。由於多數個股惜售、買盤掛單難以成交，成交值僅 4,194.05 億元、為今年以來最低；中信證券指先前放空部位被迫回補，但三大法人仍合計賣超 1,230.11 億元，新台幣收 32.939 元、貶值 4.4 分。
body.en: Spurred by Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO, the TAIEX gapped up on November 24, opening at its session low of 39,148.91 and reaching a high of 40,180.38 before closing up 3,310.46 points (8.99%) at 40,122.35, back above 40,000; 1,077 listed stocks rose, 28 fell and 7 were flat, more than 600 listed and OTC stocks were locked limit-up, and the TPEx index gained more than 8%. TSMC rose NT$200 to NT$2,230, while MediaTek reached NT$4,050, Hon Hai NT$226.5 and Delta Electronics NT$1,085, each up nearly 10%, and financials gained 8.74%. With most holders reluctant to sell and buy orders going unfilled, turnover was only NT$419.4 billion, the lowest this year; CTBC Securities cited forced short covering, yet the three major institutional groups were net sellers of NT$123.0 billion, and the Taiwan dollar weakened 4.4 cents to 32.939 per US dollar.

flows_note.zh: 三大法人中僅投信買超；自營商賣超 810.25 億元為最多。
flows_note.en: Investment trusts were the only net buyers among the three groups; dealers were the largest net sellers at NT$81.025 billion.

headline.zh: 美股：費半重挫7.9%　道瓊逆勢收逾5萬點
headline.en: US close, Nov 24: SOX tumbles 7.9% as Dow tops 50,000

body.zh: 週二（24 日）AI 與半導體股在前一日暴漲後大幅回落，費城半導體指數盤中一度重挫 9.7%，終場下跌 755.55 點（7.88%）收 8,832.50 點，那指跌 356.02 點（1.48%）收 23,733.54 點，標普 500 跌 0.50% 收 7,201.09 點；道瓊則在蘋果、微軟等走升下上漲 423.39 點（0.85%）收 50,018.70 點。輝達跌 5.86%、美光跌 10.97%、超微跌 8.86%，Anthropic 跌破發行價，台積電 ADR 跌 3.96% 收 349.2 美元，日月光 ADR 跌 8%、聯電 ADR 跌 6.88%。市場關注 AI 熱潮前景與聯準會升息風險，並靜待 25 日公布的通膨數據與美方可能加徵的新關稅；經濟數據方面，11 月經濟諮商會消費者信心指數升至 103.3。台指期夜盤下跌 1,842 點（4.57%）。
body.en: AI and chip stocks pulled back sharply on Tuesday (November 24) after the previous day's surge: the SOX fell as much as 9.7% intraday and closed down 755.55 points (7.88%) at 8,832.50, the Nasdaq lost 356.02 points (1.48%) to 23,733.54 and the S&P 500 slipped 0.50% to 7,201.09, while the Dow rose 423.39 points (0.85%) to 50,018.70 helped by gains in Apple and Microsoft. Nvidia fell 5.86%, Micron 10.97% and AMD 8.86%, Anthropic slipped below its IPO price, the TSMC ADR lost 3.96% to US$349.20, the ASE ADR fell 8% and the UMC ADR 6.88%. Investors weighed the outlook for the AI boom and the risk of Fed rate hikes ahead of inflation data on the 25th and possible new US tariffs; the Conference Board's November consumer confidence index rose to 103.3. TAIEX futures fell 1,842 points (4.57%) in the night session.
